subject: Linguistics
title: Topicalization
description: A short lesson to help you apply Topicalization.

hook.text: 'Chocolate, I love.' You moved the object to the front to emphasize it.

buildup.text: Topicalization places a word or phrase at the start of the sentence for focus or contrast.

discovery.text: Some languages like Japanese mark the topic with a dedicated particle: 'wa.'

twist.text: In English topicalization is optional and stylistic; in topic-prominent languages it's essential.

climax.text: Linguists distinguish topic-prominent from subject-prominent languages based on this feature.

punchline.text: What comes first isn't always the subject—it's the point.

quiz.question: What is topicalization?
options: Moving a phrase to the front for emphasis
